violations.text: The food prep sink does not have an airgap. The food prep sink has an airbreak. https://datahealth.ri.gov/publications/factsheets/air-gaps-backflow-prevention.pdf New Violation. Correct By: 10/13/2026
The doors to all toilet rooms (3) are not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 10/13/2026

The floor and wall junctures in the walk-in cooler and walk-in freezer and adjoining panels (walls and floors) do not have coving and/or is not sealed for effective cleanability. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 10/13/2026

The floor tiles where the floor drains meet are not finished (exposing tile and subfloor materials). Theses areas must be durable, easily cleanable and nonabsorbent due to subjectivity to moisture from food preparation and sanitiation . New Violation. Correct By: 10/13/2026
